content:
Switching from SentenceTransformer to Gemini-embedding-001

Current Setup:
- Model: intfloat/multilingual-e5-large-instruct (local SentenceTransformer)
- Dimensions: 1024
- Max tokens: 514
- Mean score: 63.22
- Storage: ~1GB local model

Target Setup (gemini-embedding-001):
- Dimensions: 3072 (3x improvement)
- Max tokens: 2048 (4x improvement)  
- Mean score: 68.37 (#1 ranked)
- API-based (no local storage)

Implementation Changes Required:

1. REPLACE EMBEDDING METHOD in chroma_provider.py:
   - Remove: self.model = SentenceTransformer(...)
   - Remove: embedding = self.model.encode(text, normalize_embeddings=True)
   - Add: Use Google provider API for embeddings
   - Add: provider.get_embedding(text, model='gemini-embedding-001')

2. HANDLE DIMENSION CHANGE:
   - ChromaDB automatically handles new 3072 dimensions
   - Existing 1024D embeddings incompatible with new 3072D
   - Requires re-embedding all existing entries

3. ADD GEMINI EMBEDDING SUPPORT:
   - Extend Google provider with embedding capability
   - Handle API authentication (already have Gemini API key)
   - Implement proper error handling and retries

4. MIGRATION PROCESS:
   - Phase 1: Add Gemini support alongside existing
   - Phase 2: Re-embed all content with new model
   - Phase 3: Remove old SentenceTransformer code

Benefits:
- 3x more semantic nuance (3072 vs 1024 dimensions)
- 4x longer text support (2048 vs 514 tokens)
- Better multilingual support
- No local model management
- Automatic model updates by Google

Estimated Work: 4-6 hours total
- API integration: 2-3 hours
- Data migration: 1 hour
- Testing: 1-2 hours
